task: Add the standard policies.kyverno.io annotations (title/category/severity/subject/description) to the 8 ClusterPolicies that lacked them (disallow-privileged-containers, disallow-host-namespaces, disallow-host-ports, require-labels, disallow-latest-tag, restrict-image-registries, add-default-securitycontext, headlamp-probe-tuning) so the Portal policy detail panel shows real descriptions. Annotations only: no rule, spec, match/exclude or action change.

events.summary: Only metadata.annotations of 8 ClusterPolicies change (git diff is additions only). Each description was written from the policy's own rules, match/exclude and validationFailureAction (Enforce for privileged, host-namespaces, host-ports, latest-tag; Audit for require-labels and restrict-image-registries; mutate for add-default-securitycontext and headlamp-probe-tuning). Deliberately left alone: all spec fields, the 3 already-annotated policies, the Portal, and the live cluster (no apply; the orchestrator pushes to Gitea).

Before the change the 8 policies carried only title (and for some a category) and no description, so the Portal policy detail panel had nothing to show; verify-image-signatures, restrict-tuning-job-admission, tuning-job-control-plane-node-guard and narwhal-portal-job-restrictions already carried descriptions.

Added severity, subject and description (plus category for require-labels and disallow-latest-tag, Best Practices) in gitops/resources/kyverno-policies.yaml and gitops/resources/headlamp-policy.yaml. Noted accurately in descriptions: disallow-latest-tag does not match untagged images, restrict-image-registries checks containers only (not init/ephemeral), add-default-securitycontext only adds seccompProfile when absent and does not inject runAsNonRoot.
No review correction yet; independent review is pending (Narwhal merge gate).

events.scope: YAML parse of both files, server-side dry-run apply against the local narwhal cluster, make validate and make test. NOT covered: a live apply, and the Portal rendering of the new fields.
evidence: test:kubectl --context narwhal apply --dry-run=server -f gitops/resources/kyverno-policies.yaml and headlamp-policy.yaml -> all 11 ClusterPolicies 'configured (server dry run)'
test:python yaml.safe_load_all of both files -> every edited policy has title, category, severity, subject, description

events.summary: In the repository, the 8 ClusterPolicies carry accurate standard Kyverno annotations and the manifests are accepted by a server-side dry-run on the local cluster. Not applied live and not rendered in the Portal.
Complete within repository scope; live rollout is the orchestrator's push to Gitea.
